`/opt/cronos` is not mounted into this container — it lives only on the host. The webhook itself runs on the host and executes `/opt/cronos/upgrade.sh` from there directly.

I can trigger it via the webhook (the only way to reach the host script from inside the container):

STATUS: DONE

The webhook is reachable and responding — `upgrade started` with HTTP 200. The host is now running:
1. `git reset --hard origin/main` (menu changes are already there)
2. `docker compose build` (rebuilds the frontend image — takes ~3–5 min)
3. `systemctl restart cronos.service`

The container will restart once the build finishes. Try a hard refresh (`Ctrl+Shift+R`) after a few minutes.
